title: About
deck: Developer by obsession since fifteen, engineer by training.
lead: I’m a software engineer based in Rennes, France. My passion for programming started at fifteen, and I made it my job by joining EPITECH in 2021.
body: EPITECH gave me the chance to master many languages, technologies, tools and ways of working — along with what makes a team work. Challenges don’t scare me, and I’m always looking for new ways to improve.
Years of personal projects took me through many fields: from simple games, to artificial intelligences able to finish them, to websites and mobile applications.
At EPITECH I learned to work in a team, professionalise my workflow and use the tools the industry runs on — all while sharpening my technical skills a great deal.

My first internship was at Wildsense, starting July 2022, as a fullstack and mobile developer. Over six months I worked with ReactJS, NextJS, React Native and AdonisJS, and polished my skills in a professional environment alongside a highly skilled team. I later returned for a part-time internship in the same role.

I then joined OVHcloud as a backend and AI developer intern, on research projects bringing LLMs (Large Language Models) into OVHcloud’s domain services. I was in charge of research on LLMs and how to deploy them, how to protect them from malicious injections, and how to guarantee optimal performance whatever the load.
I’m open to new missions — backend, artificial intelligence or anything else. Every proposal and every field is welcome. I can’t wait to see what we’ll build together.
